About.description: At Tecrix, we specialize in providing cutting-edge solutions in the fields of instructional design and AI development. Led by Talha Arif, a top-rated freelancer on Upwork, we bring expert-level knowledge and innovative approaches to every project. Our focus is on creating transformative learning experiences and developing advanced AI technologies that drive success for businesses and individuals alike. Whether you’re looking for customized training solutions or AI-driven advancements, Tecrix is your trusted partner in navigating the future of technology and education.

Testimonial.text: We are very happy to work with Tecrix. The collaboration goes far beyond a standard IT service: with Tecrix we have a sparring partner that challenges us in our product decisions and is truly passionate about the results developed. The level of professionalism and dedication is exceptional in this industry and we are eager to strengthen our collaboration in the future.
Testimonial.author: Muhammad Talha Arif

About.title: About Us
About.subtitle: Experience, Rigor, and a User-Centric Approach.
About.helloDesc: You’re here to build something meaningful, and we’re here to help make it happen. As product experts, designers, and engineers, we plug into your team to sharpen your vision, cut through noise, and get you from idea to traction with the leanest, smartest path forward.
About.whyUsDesc: Because we’ve been in your shoes. Tecrix was built by ex-founders who’ve launched startups, failed fast, raised capital, exited, and everything in between. That journey taught us the hard truths of turning vision into products that actually succeed.
About.beyondWorkDesc: We regularly organize all-hand events to meet as a team and do fun stuff together.
About.meetFoundersDesc: Our founding team started their journeys in the corporate world. They studied lean product development through building startups from the ground up with very few resources.
About.meetTeamDesc: We have a rigorous screening process to identify the best talent, from inception, UX/UI design, and development.

ServicesPage.title: We design & build innovative products focused on user’s needs
ServicesPage.subtitle: Together, we can transform your vision into a thriving business, be it through a Minimum Viable Product, UX/UI services, or scaling support for your company.
ServicesPage.howWeWorkDesc: We believe there are no excuses to build anything less than great technology products. The core of our operations lies in helping you craft and launch tailored, innovative solutions designed to delight your users.
ServicesPage.extendedTeamDesc: At our core, we design and build high-quality, user-centric software products for entrepreneurs and business leaders.
ServicesPage.tangibleResultsDesc: We have an enviable track record of helping two-thirds of our clients achieve VC funding in an ecosystem where only ~0.05% of startups ever see that landmark.
ServicesPage.topTalentDesc: We work with the best and brightest in tech talent to ensure you get high-quality tech architecture.
ServicesPage.provenTrackDesc: With over 80 successful projects delivered, our product, UX/UI, and software development teams consistently turn ideas into impactful digital solutions.
ServicesPage.businessMindsetDesc: We know there is more to a successful product than technology, so we will always look at your product from a business standpoint.
ServicesPage.userCentricDesc: We value your end-user above specifications. We take the time to understand your client’s needs and desires.
